task.subject: Failed workflow runs requiring investigation
task.intent: Show failed runs in a bounded, actionable queue with the failure step and message, workflow identity, run provenance, and a link to each run; do not mistake a successful run for accepted repository output.
activationConditions: The selected repository has workflow runs in the last 30 days.
At least one run has a failure conclusion and available failure details.
requiredEffects: List only runs with a failure conclusion at run grain, newest first.
Expose the failing step, message, workflow, and run link so an operator can investigate the failure.
noopConditions: No failed runs are observed within the selected horizon.
Run evidence is unavailable; an empty queue must not imply that all runs succeeded.
successConditions: The operator can navigate from a failed run to its source run without inferring failure details from unrelated findings.
The failure queue stays bounded and is ordered deterministically by start time and run identity.
uncertainties: A failed run may have no populated failure message or step.
A run conclusion does not establish whether a safe output was accepted.
Missing run observations are not evidence that the workflow did not execute.

operationalValue.preservation: Preserve the upstream metric identity, ordering, native value or null, unit, and direction; a run failure count is not a substitute for the metric.
